items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: Interviewer notes credits: 'Mack Rabinac... And then it's got Matassa... Did you, were you a writer?' Interviewee confirms: 'I was a part of the conspiracy... Mostly lyrics, actually.'

ctx.x: But under writer's credits, it's got Mack Rabinac. This is the Chuck Carbo song, Promise. Mack Rabinac. I guess it's Seth David. Yeah. And then it's got Matassa. It's got you. Yeah. Did you, were you a writer? What was it? I'll work on it.
You've got to know all these things have gone in the studio.
